categories.label: Recovery Setups

cmp_note: CMP is the latest official NSE bar (Kite overlay when the market is open; otherwise last EOD). Entry, stop and target are shown only when the scan already stored them — this desk does not invent 5%/10% plans. Each scan symbol maps to one primary category (breakout → recovery → trend). Buy requires two independent evidence families (price leadership, structure, quality, earnings change, sector, participation, catalyst), a why-now, and a ready non-extended entry. SEPA alone is not a Buy. Correlated tape / RS / momentum count as one Price Leadership family. Missing stays unknown.

ensemble.empty_detail: Checked 23 scored names across Business Quality, Catalyst, Fundamental Change, Market Context, Participation, Price Leadership, Structure. Independent evidence families did not agree on a ready, non-extended high-conviction setup. Empty is a successful output — the desk does not invent a Buy list. Good setups: 4; watch: 19.

methods_note: Mixture of experts over saved evidence: SEPA, cross-sectional momentum, RS, breakout quality, VCP, trend pullback, earnings momentum, business quality, momentum+quality, sector leadership, participation, catalyst. Confidence is agreement across evidence families, not indicator count. Tape, RS and momentum are one Price Leadership family. A Buy needs two families, a why-now, and a ready non-extended entry. SEPA 100 with funds 0 is not enough. Empty high-conviction is success.
